authorization: User requested acceleration after accepting the reviewed bounded principles proposal.
design_type: Retrospective fixed-case analysis and prospective offline diagnostic replay of exposed cases
complete_context_panels: gp_generated_effect_v1: four tasks, all P/GP paths, separate original arm outcomes
raw_issue_feedback_effect_v2: all eight tasks and shared-prefix policies
search_replace_chooser_v1: all four tasks and original paired endpoints
claim_unit: An explicitly stated property relative to an identified object, consumer and use, not an entire skill

principles.statement: Define the intended use before choosing the extraction boundary.
principles.condition: Preserve or explicitly adapt the input, state, configuration and consumer dependencies relevant to that use; reachability does not guarantee utility.

principles.statement: Carry the checked object and asserted property with the evidence.
principles.condition: Do not transfer a hard guarantee to a different object or property without justification; limited evidence may still be useful as a soft signal.

principles.statement: Derive controls from the actual producer path and an explicit obligation.
principles.condition: Use real input transformations for properties that requirements or adaptations actually require preserving; old behavior alone is not authority.

hypotheses.H1: Identify what evidence tracing adds beyond a concrete original-object syntax admission fix.
hypotheses.H1_factorial_decision: CANCELLED_BEFORE_REPLAY: no distinct operational scope treatment was identified; scope metadata alone does not change the policy, and the old receipt already recorded issue_fixed=null.
hypotheses.H1_allowed_conclusion: A syntax intervention may demonstrate a local policy change; extra prevention value of generic scope handling remains unestablished.
hypotheses.H2: Compare fixed direct-helper controls and controls derived from the actual producer path on the recorded JSON-path variants.
hypotheses.H2_competing_explanation: An equivalent direct-helper control may detect the same difference; production-path analysis may provide control construction rather than a uniquely stronger oracle.

freeze_rule: Each group protocol fixes exact fixtures, input sources, expected observations and mock boundaries before its first execution.
execution_boundaries: Read only public pinned source and explicitly identified public records; never credentials, private task annotations or hidden tests.
No model calls, containers, donor entry programs with external side effects, benchmark jobs or scoring jobs.
Leave all historical frozen code, artifacts, score populations and outcomes unchanged.
Record exact source slices and mocks; do not present a surrogate implementation as the original program.
Existing original scoring continuation is separate; no individual scores before its complete release.
stopping_rules: At most two working-day batches and the group fixture caps; do not expand samples to rescue a hypothesis.
Allow at most one ordinary implementation-fix pass in a group. Retain any failed attempt and distinguish implementation fixes from changed hypotheses.
Changing a principle, property or control to obtain a favorable result ends that version; do not relabel it as the same confirmation.
Missing source or dependencies remain unassessed. New reduced models must be labeled illustrative.
Report legitimate-control rejection, abstention, unresolved evidence and additional human interpretation along with detection.
Do not pool heterogeneous fixtures into a success rate or interpret replay agreement as new benchmark gains.
